fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: EN dub battle/unit voice index for Sound_Voice_0.dat (voice_en/NNNNNN.dat packs). For a new unit: either reuse an existing voice group via char.dat voice id, or add a voice pack + rows.

fields.name: id
fields.desc: voice line id = group*1000 + n; the sound is member "%09d.vag" of the group file

fields.name: group
fields.desc: voice set: file "voice_en/%06d.dat" (a DSARC FL pack) inside Data/Sound_Voice/Sound_Voice_0.dat. group = voice_type*100000 + char voice id*10 (+variant): e.g. 100 Killia, 110 Killia(alt), 400 Seraphina, 500 Red Magnus, 1010x = Warrior (generic classes have types 0..3 -> 010100/110100/210100/310100 and sub variants x0/x1/x2). char.dat u16 +0xF6 *10 matches 575/806 characters (other agent maps char.dat)

fields.name: volume
fields.desc: volume 15..100 (JP/EN dubs differ here)
